_description: Cash-only portfolio, zero yield, zero inflation — verifies tax-free principal pulls and linear drawdown.
_rationale: 100k cash, 50k/yr spending, 0% yield, 0% returns, 0% inflation, Florida (0% state). Cash withdrawals are tax-free principal, so totalTax should be 0 every year. Linear drawdown: 100k/50k = 2 years. Starts age 60, runs out age 62. Life expectancy 75. Fails every time → 0%. Demonstrates that cash works as a fourth account type with no tax pipeline regressions.
name: Cash Account Basic
